name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
summary: Income support of Rs 6,000 per year to landholding farmer families, paid in three instalments of Rs 2,000 directly to the bank account.
eligibility: Farmer families owning cultivable land. Not eligible: institutional landholders, income-tax payers, serving or retired government officers (except Group D), professionals such as doctors and lawyers, and pensioners getting Rs 10,000 or more per month.
benefit: Rs 6,000 per year in 3 instalments of Rs 2,000.
how_to_apply: Register at pmkisan.gov.in (Farmers Corner) or at the nearest CSC / Lekhpal office. Complete e-KYC with Aadhaar.
keywords: farmer kisan khet land acres agriculture income support kheti zameen किसान खेत ज़मीन जमीन खेती एकड़ बीघा सम्मान निधि

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
summary: Free hospital treatment cover of Rs 5 lakh per family per year at empanelled government and private hospitals.
eligibility: Families listed in the SECC 2011 deprived categories or identified rural and urban occupational categories, and all senior citizens aged 70 and above. Check the name on mera.pmjay.gov.in or at a CSC.
benefit: Cashless health cover up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year.
how_to_apply: Check eligibility at mera.pmjay.gov.in or call 14555. Get the Ayushman card made at a CSC, Ayushman Mitra at a hospital, or through the Ayushman app.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMSS)
summary: Scholarship of Rs 12,000 per year for talented students from low-income families to continue school education in classes 9 to 12.
eligibility: Student passed class 8 with at least 55% marks (50% for SC/ST), studying in a government or aided school, parental income not above Rs 3.5 lakh per year. Selected through a state-level exam taken in class 8.
benefit: Rs 12,000 per year, paid directly to the student's bank account till class 12.
how_to_apply: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) after selection; school nodal officer verifies the application.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship (Uttar Pradesh, classes 9 and 10)
summary: State scholarship for students of classes 9 and 10 from SC, ST, OBC, general and minority families with limited income.
eligibility: Resident of Uttar Pradesh studying in class 9 or 10 in a recognised school; family income limit applies (about Rs 2 lakh per year for most categories; check the latest notice).
benefit: Annual scholarship amount and fee support credited to the student's bank account.
how_to_apply: Apply online at scholarship.up.gov.in during the open window, then submit the printout to the school.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
summary: Savings scheme for a girl child with high interest and tax benefits, for her education and marriage expenses.
eligibility: Account can be opened by parents or guardians for a girl child below 10 years of age. Maximum two girls per family (exceptions for twins/triplets).
benefit: Government-set interest rate (higher than most savings schemes). Deposit Rs 250 to Rs 1.5 lakh per year. Partial withdrawal for education after the girl turns 18.
documents: Aadhaar / ID and address proof of parent
how_to_apply: Open the account at any post office or authorised bank with the first deposit of at least Rs 250.

name: PM Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
summary: Financial help to build a pucca house with a toilet for rural families that have no house or live in a kutcha house.
eligibility: Rural households with no pucca house, listed in the Awaas+ / SECC survey list. Priority to SC/ST, widows, disabled persons, and bonded labour families.
benefit: Rs 1.20 lakh in plain areas (Rs 1.30 lakh in hilly areas), plus support for a toilet and up to 90 days of MGNREGA wages.
how_to_apply: Contact the Gram Panchayat or Block Development Office; the Gram Sabha confirms the list and surveyors geo-tag the house.

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
summary: Free LPG gas connection for women from poor households, so they can stop cooking on firewood and dung cakes.
eligibility: Adult woman from a BPL or priority household (SC/ST, PMAY, Antyodaya, forest dwellers, tea garden workers, etc.) with no LPG connection in the family.
benefit: Free LPG connection with a deposit-free first cylinder and stove support; targeted subsidy on refills.
how_to_apply: Apply at the nearest LPG distributor or at pmuy.gov.in with the KYC form.

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
summary: Crop insurance that pays the farmer when crops are lost because of flood, drought, hail, pests or unseasonal rain.
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas, including sharecroppers and tenant farmers.
benefit: Insurance cover for crop loss. Farmer pays only 2% of the sum insured for kharif crops, 1.5% for rabi crops and 5% for cash crops; the government pays the rest.
how_to_apply: Apply through your bank, CSC, insurance agent or pmfby.gov.in before the cut-off date of the season.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
summary: Low-interest short-term farm loan for seeds, fertiliser and other farming needs, so farmers do not depend on moneylenders.
eligibility: Farmers who own or cultivate land, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, and self-help groups of farmers; also fishermen and animal-rearing farmers.
benefit: Credit up to Rs 3 lakh at about 4% effective interest with prompt repayment (interest subvention), plus accident insurance.
how_to_apply: Apply at your bank branch or cooperative bank, or through the PM-KISAN portal KCC option.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
summary: Guaranteed monthly pension of Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 after age 60 for workers in the unorganised sector, in return for a small monthly contribution.
eligibility: Indian citizen aged 18 to 40 with a savings bank account and mobile number. Income-tax payers are not eligible.
benefit: Fixed pension of Rs 1,000 / 2,000 / 3,000 / 4,000 / 5,000 per month from age 60, depending on contribution; benefit passes to spouse and nominee.
how_to_apply: Open an APY account at your bank or post office and set up auto-debit of the monthly contribution.

name: Old Age Pension (NSAP / State Pension)
summary: Monthly pension for poor senior citizens, widows and disabled persons under the National Social Assistance Programme and state schemes.
eligibility: Age 60 or above (old age), widows, or persons with disability (40% or more) from BPL / low-income families. State rules and income limits apply.
benefit: Monthly pension credited to the bank account (amount differs by state; in Uttar Pradesh it is paid via the Social Welfare department).
documents: Age proof (birth certificate, school certificate or ration card)
Death certificate of husband (widows) / disability certificate
how_to_apply: Apply online on the state social welfare portal (UP: sspy-up.gov.in) or through the Gram Panchayat / CSC.

name: PM Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
summary: Cash support for pregnant and nursing mothers to help with nutrition and rest before and after delivery.
eligibility: Pregnant women and lactating mothers for the first living child (and for a second child if it is a girl, as per the latest guidelines). Government employees are not eligible.
benefit: Rs 5,000 in instalments for the first child, plus Rs 1,000 under Janani Suraksha for institutional delivery where applicable.
how_to_apply: Register at the nearest Anganwadi Centre or ASHA worker, or on the PMMVY portal.

name: PM Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
summary: Zero-balance bank account with RuPay debit card, accident insurance and overdraft facility, so every household can access banking.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen aged 10 and above without a bank account.
benefit: Zero-balance account, RuPay card with Rs 2 lakh accident insurance, direct transfer of all government benefits, and overdraft up to Rs 10,000.
documents: Aadhaar card (or any officially valid ID)
how_to_apply: Visit any bank branch or Bank Mitra (Business Correspondent) in your village and fill the account opening form.

name: PM Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
summary: Collateral-free loans for small businesses, shopkeepers, artisans and self-employed people to start or grow their work.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen with a non-farm small business plan in manufacturing, trading or services. Loan categories: Shishu (up to Rs 50,000), Kishore (up to Rs 5 lakh), Tarun (up to Rs 10 lakh).
benefit: Loan without collateral up to Rs 10 lakh from banks, NBFCs and microfinance institutions.
how_to_apply: Apply at any bank branch or on udyamimitra.in with a simple business plan.

name: MGNREGA (Mahatma Gandhi Rural Employment Guarantee)
summary: Legal guarantee of 100 days of paid unskilled work per year for every rural household that asks for it.
eligibility: Any adult member of a rural household willing to do unskilled manual work. Registration with the Gram Panchayat is free.
benefit: Up to 100 days of wage employment per household per year at the state-notified daily wage, paid to the bank account within about 15 days.
documents: Application to Gram Panchayat for a Job Card
how_to_apply: Apply to the Gram Panchayat for a Job Card, then submit a written request for work. If no work is given in 15 days, you are entitled to an unemployment allowance.
